candidate_relations.reason: There is no allogeneic transplant; graft-versus-host disease is not peristomal pemphigus vulgaris.
Stoma site complication is a nonspecific parent of the peristomal erosion and omits pemphigus vulgaris.
Autoimmune enteropathy is an intestinal mucosal disease, not cutaneous pemphigus; the bowel disease is Crohn disease.

case_quality_flags: Suprabasal acantholysis with intercellular IgG/C3 and high Dsg3/Dsg1 antibodies around a stoma is peristomal PV; no candidate names pemphigus.
